title: chore: drop the npm age-gate exemption now the bump is locked
description:
## Summary

Removes the `npmPreapprovedPackages` exemption added for the
safe-deployments 1.37.62 bump. The `npmMinimalAgeGate` only applies at
resolution time — installing from the existing lockfile is unaffected, so
CI and local `yarn install --immutable` keep working without it (verified).

With the standing exemption gone, any future bump landing inside a
package's 7-day publication window requires a deliberate, temporary
exemption instead of a permanent bypass — a compromised org publish token
no longer has an instant path into CI.

## Changes

- `.yarnrc.yml` — remove the `npmPreapprovedPackages` entry; the age gate
  itself stays as is
